target.label: Keep your tempo: lowering within 25% of your first three reps

datasetCard.labelDefinition: Bounds: within 25% of the median lowering duration of the set's first 3 counted reps. v_t = 1 when the lowering duration of counted rep t is outside the bounds. The event is the set's first sustained departure: the first rep k with v_k = 1 and at least 2 of reps k..k+2 outside. Y_t = 1 when that departure starts at one of reps t+1..t+5. Origins need 3 counted reps, v_t = 0 and no departure yet; an origin whose deciding reps include an uncounted attempt, or run past the end of the set, or that lies after the departure, is excluded.
limitations: Labels are produced by the rep counter, not by independent annotation.
Development clips were used to tune the counter.

dev.protocol: leave-one-person-out; lambda by nested leave-one-person-out log loss

bootstrap.note: Fixed out-of-fold predictions resampled by recording; does not include model-selection uncertainty.

dev.primaryComparison: Brier score of the full logistic model against the constant baseline (bootstrap interval of the difference); policy: event recall of the full model at the selected threshold against the existing slow-ascent rule, both under the false-alert budget.

regression.note: Separate fallback experiment; not the primary question.

personal.note: Each held set is predicted using the clips and only this person's earlier sets; thresholds frozen from the main development selection.
